trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** The live version was v2.3.1, which was failing health checks everywhere with an 18% error rate. The version before it, v2.3.1-rc, was also unhealthy, so I went back one more step to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy release. us-east, us-west and eu-west are all on v2.3.0 now. A status check afterwards shows the service healthy, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 says what failed, what I rolled back to, and the results after the rollback. It also notes that the problem in v2.3.1 needs to be found before anyone redeploys it.
  - My first attempt to create the incident timed out. The incident list was still empty afterwards, so I tried again with the same duplicate-prevention key. Only one incident exists.

content.text: The most recent healthy release is v2.3.0 (seq 1). Both v2.3.1-rc (seq 2) and v2.3.1 (seq 3) are unhealthy. I'm rolling back to v2.3.0.
